name.description: what the provider is called; the entity id is derived from it
the model's own name; the entity id is derived from it

effort.description: the reasoning effort requested, unless a session overrides it

serves.description: an edge relation: this provider serves that model

name.description: what the provider calls the model, sent as the model of every request it serves

usage.description: provider-reported token counts for one completed model request, stored on the entry for that request; not cumulative, and not an estimate of current context size

input_tokens.description: input context tokens, including cached tokens

total_tokens.description: total input and output tokens reported by the provider

cached_tokens.description: input tokens read from the provider cache; not a guarantee of future cache availability

questions.description: typed questions about the transcript, asked with the next request and answered by one `answer` entry each rather than in prose

asked.description: each question by its name, in Jev's terms: {type: noul, choice or score, instructions, criteria}

answer.description: a model's answer to one typed question, in the terms it was asked in

question.description: the name of the question it answers

noul.description: for a noul, the probability that it holds

choice.description: for a choice, the option chosen

score.description: for a score, where along its criteria the answer falls

confidence.description: how sure the model is of a choice or a score, from 0 to 1

probabilities.description: each option's probability, by the option's name or place
